<!-- Generated by genconfdocs from the config structs in server/config. Do not edit. -->

See OAuthConfig for details on provider URL, scopes, and field mapping from OIDC claims to ssoossh identity fields (username, groups).

## `authentication.client_id`

`string`, default `empty`

The OAuth2/OIDC client ID registered with the identity provider. Required.

## `authentication.client_secret`

`string`, default `empty`

The OAuth2 client secret.

## `authentication.provider_url`

`string`, default `empty`

The OIDC provider's issuer URL, used for discovery. A trailing /.well-known/openid-configuration is stripped automatically. Required.

## `authentication.scopes`

`string`, default `profile email`

A space-separated list of additional scopes to request alongside the always-included "openid" scope, e.g. "profile email".

## `authentication.fields`

Maps ssoossh identity fields to claim names in the OIDC provider's ID token. Username is the only required field; the rest are empty by default, meaning "not populated from OIDC".

## `authentication.fields.username`

`string`, default `preferred_username`

Names the claim holding the local account username, e.g. "preferred_username". Required.

## `authentication.fields.groups`

`string`, default `groups`

Names a claim expected to hold a JSON array of group names. It feeds the certificate lifetime and require-group decision only; group membership is never placed in an issued certificate (see docs/internals/invariants.md).

## `authentication.fields.other_accounts`

`string`, default `empty`

Names a claim expected to hold a JSON array of alternate account identifiers this identity is known by on target systems (a different username, UPN, or sAMAccountName), added to a certificate's principal list alongside the username claim.

## `authentication.fields.service_accounts`

`string`, default `empty`

Names a claim expected to hold a JSON array of service-account identifiers this identity is authorized to manage and enroll certificates for.

## `authentication.fields.email`

`string`, default `email`

Names the claim to read the user's email from. Empty falls back to the standard "email" claim opportunistically (not an error if absent either way).

## `authentication.fields.extra`

`map`

Maps additional template field names to claim names. Each configured claim is captured at login (scalars as strings, string arrays as lists), stored on the users row, and made available to key ID templates as {{.Extra.<name>}} (or {{join .Extra.<name> "<sep>"}} for lists). A claim absent from the ID token stores empty and renders as MISSING; login never fails over one. Names with characters beyond letters/digits/underscores need the template's index syntax: {{index .Extra "my-name"}}.
